description_en: Queries stream-level batch data for a specified streaming domain. Multiple protocols are supported
description_zh: 用于查询指定加速域名下的流粒度批量数据，支持多种协议
name: DescribeLiveUserStreamMetricData

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain to query.


Only a single domain name is supported. An error is returned if multiple domain names are specified. If the domain name is empty, aggregate data for all streaming domains under the user is queried. If `AppName` and `StreamName` are not specified, stream-level data for all streams under the domain is returned
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。


仅支持单个域名查询，传多个域名将报错。域名为空时，查询用户下的所有加速域名的聚合数据。不指定 `AppName` 和 `StreamName` 时，按域名返回所有流粒度的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time and the difference cannot exceed 1 day. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间需大于起始时间，不能相差超过 1 天；日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The application name. Specify the application name to query stream-level data for the corresponding application. If `StreamName` is specified, `AppName` must also be specified
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称。指定应用名称，查询对应应用流粒度的数据；指定 `StreamName` 时，必须指定 `AppName`
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. If `StreamName` is specified, stream-level data for the specified `StreamName` under the specified `AppName` is returned. If `StreamName` is specified, `AppName` must also be specified
parameters.help_zh: 流名称。指定 `StreamName` 时，按指定 `AppName` 的指定 `StreamName`，返回流粒度的数据（指定 `StreamName` 时，必须指定 `AppName`）
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The stream protocol name. Specify the protocol name to query data for the corresponding protocol. Supported protocols: `flv`, `hls`, `rtmp`, `rts`, `p2p`. You can query data for multiple protocols by separating them with commas (,). Data for multiple protocols is not aggregated and is output at the stream level.
The rts option queries Real-Time Streaming (RTS) streams using the ARTC protocol.
When using rts, you may need to additionally count the xxx_AliRTS-opus transcoding stream. This is because when playing an RTS stream on the web, a transcoding stream with the _AliRTS-opus suffix appended to the stream name is automatically generated, producing transcoding stream data. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2948703.html
parameters.help_zh:
流协议名。指定流协议名查询流对应协议的数据，目前支持：`flv`, `hls`, `rtmp`, `rts`, `p2p`。支持查询多个协议的数据，协议间用 `,` 分隔，多个协议的数据不会聚合，按照流的粒度输出。
rts选项可查询artc协议的超低延时直播流。
使用rts可能需要额外统计xxx_AliRTS-opu转码流。原因：Web端播超低延时直播时，会生成流名后加上_AliRTS-opus后缀的转码流进行自动转码，产生转码流数据。详细请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2948703.html
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 5000
parameters.help_zh: 单页数据条数，单页最大5000
parameters.name: page_size
